details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_judge_interim_round_trip.py:~567 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The script-mode test runner only catches Exception, so BaseException subclasses can bypass failure accounting and abort the run.
  WHY: This is a hardening gap rather than an active bug today; the reviewer noted all current test failures are Exception subclasses.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:103–109 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The JSON validator accepts bool values for line_start and line_end because bool is a subclass of int.
  WHY: A payload with true/false can pass validation and silently become 1/0, which is a real correctness issue.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:153–161 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The priors JSON validator has the same bool-vs-int acceptance bug for line_start and line_end.
  WHY: Bool values can pass the current isinstance(int) checks and be treated as valid line numbers.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:239 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Capturing the full git diff into a shell variable risks truncation or failure on large diffs.
  WHY: Large PR output can exceed shell argument/variable limits, leaving the judge prompt incomplete or empty.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:204–209 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The reasoning-effort allowlist accepts none even though it is not part of the documented repo-wide set.
  WHY: Setting that value may be rejected by the provider and the allowlist is inconsistent with the rest of the pipeline.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:174–182 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The round-number fallback path has a potential off-by-one/cache-miss fragility under an edge-case startup sequence.
  WHY: The reviewer considered the documented flow correct, but flagged the fallback contract as fragile.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:52–71 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: load_candidates can add duplicate JSON candidates when both cleaned text and raw_decode find the same object.
  WHY: This wastes CPU but does not change validation behavior.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:666–669 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The embedded priors block is capped at 20000 bytes and may silently truncate if the file grows large.
  WHY: Truncation could hide carry-over items from the editor prompt even though the mechanism is otherwise functional.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:274–293 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trap was flagged as potentially racing with concurrent invocations sharing the same temporary root.
  WHY: The reviewer noted the current single-shot flow is safe, so this is only an informational concern.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:319 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The interim judge timeout omits --kill-after, so a codex child that ignores SIGTERM can keep the step running long past the budget.
  WHY: Without a kill-after grace period, the script may never classify the run as a timeout and can burn the rest of the job wall-clock.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
